Ashwin: Heads-up — seeing reproducible token-drop on canary with AWQ group_size=48 + act_quant=4. Latency fine but decode artifacts for long prefixes.
Maria: Can you paste the log snippet / serve config?
Ashwin: paste log: ```
model=redwood-v2-opus
quant=awq
group_size=48
act_quant=4
serve_rev=canary-ashwin-2026-03-18
[WARN] decode: token_drop_rate=0.032
[DEBUG] seq_len=768, kv_cache_miss=0.012
[ERROR] decode_align: mismatch at step 412
```
Jon: Is this only with group=48? did you try 24 / 12?
Ashwin: Yes — group=24 reduces token_drop to ~0.01 but p95 latency +8ms. group=12 looks stable but throughput drops ~11%.
Sophie: @Ashwin can you try act_quant=3 on that same canary?
Ashwin: quick run: actq=3 => token_drop down ~60% from baseline, memory +8% (within margin). eval on short/long samples shows no metric regression.
Maria: Any pattern by sequence length or prompt shape?
Ashwin: Spikes mainly >512 tokens, especially when many past tokens in cache. Points to activation quant saturation / accumulation error with large group sizes + long kv chains.
Jon: Proposal: try hybrid profile: group=32 + actq=3, enable prefix_warmup=true, and add a fallback route for sequences >1024 to fp16 replica.
Ashwin: Pushed canary: group=32, actq=3, prefix_warmup=true. Monitoring dashboards and slowlog.
infra-bot: Deploy canary started: canary_id=canary-2200001111-ashwin-1 status=started
Sophie: If the numbers hold, we should codify this as a serve-profile and add a regression test in the eval harness for long-context perplexity.
Maria: I'll queue an eval job: long-context-regressions (200 samples, seqs up to 1500).
Ashwin: Prelim results (1h): group=32/actq=3 => token_drop ~0.002, p95 latency +12ms, cost +2%. Rolling to 10% traffic now.
Jon: Nice. Keep an eye on GPU memory and OOMs. If memory climbs, consider dynamic group sizing based on seq_len or an adaptive actq knob.
Ashwin: Will do. Logging baseline + canary traces to /mnt/awq/serve/2200001111-canary.json and will post updated metrics in this thread.
Maria: Good work — thanks for the fast triage. :thumbsup:
Sophie: Adding follow-up: create a smoke test that runs 50 long prompts against new quant profiles before any canary.
Ashwin: noted — I'll add smoke and a brief runbook for oncall to revert to fp16 fallback if token_drop > 0.01 on canary.
